text:
lee: heads-up: thinking about a 'triage inbox' in Rollouts for autofallback hits — collects representative samples and offers quick actions (dismiss / escalate / rollback). want low-friction ops flow.

anya: sounds good. call it 'triage' rather than 'quarantine' to avoid confusion with playback.

ravi: runtime note: each sample should include `trigger_reason`, `latency_ms`, `model_variant`, `route`, `decision_trace_id`. those are tiny and useful.

lee: privacy-first: redact by default. show a masked snippet and `requester_email` only if granted. any de-redaction must write an audit entry with justification.

ops-bot: notice: enabling sampling on route `/v2/generate` with 1% sample -> est storage 12GB/month (compressed).

anya: UI: compact card view, reason badge, timestamp, cluster tag, and an "auto-suggest" action from the classifier (e.g. `increase_timeout`, `switch-variant`). allow quick apply or queue.

ravi: auto-suggest should include confidence and the rule that fired. operator can accept, edit, or reject. all choices stored on the sample.

lee: export needs: CSV with `sample_id, route, trigger_reason, model_variant, decision_trace_id, tags, operator_action` for postmortems. include link back to decision_trace.

anya: to avoid inbox noise, do clustering: group similar inputs (simhash + kmeans), show cluster representative + count. default cluster window = 6h. bulk actions apply to whole cluster.

ops-bot: policy note: raw payloads retained encrypted for 90 days for enterprise tenants; default retention = 7 days for standard.

ravi: API sketch: `GET /rollouts/{id}/triage?page=&cluster_id=&filter=` `POST /rollouts/{id}/triage/{sample_id}/action` body `{action, comment, operator}` `POST /rollouts/{id}/triage/bulk` for cluster ops.

lee: permission model: `triage.view`, `triage.annotate`, `triage.export`. any de-redaction requires `triage.audit` and creates an audit record.

anya: edge-case: high-volume noisy routes. implement per-route caps + adaptive downsampling: if triggers > threshold, reduce effective sample probability using a decaying multiplier. show estimated missed-sample rate in UI.

ravi: i'll do a runtime spike: simulate steady 10k reqs/min with 0.1% sampling and check latency / p95. will report impact.

ops-bot: reminder: making rollout config changes will schedule a schema migration for samples table; expect short migration window.

lee: next actions: I'll mock UX flows and copy for privacy defaults. @ravi runtime spike, @anya cluster UX + bulk actions, ops to confirm storage math. target: 1-week prototype.

ravi: ack. starting spike tomorrow. :coffee:

anya: will sketch cluster UI by EOD.

lee: thanks all. we'll keep default conservative and surface cost + privacy clearly.
